description: When is the next US CPI (Consumer Price Index) inflation release? Returns the next release date and time in US Eastern, UTC and your time zone (London by default), its reference month, and the following scheduled CPI dates (up to 12). Source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI schedule page. Gives dates only, not the inflation figures, and does not cover the PCE price index (a Bureau of Economic Analysis release). (cost: 1 credit)

timezone.description: string, optional, IANA time zone for the local time fields (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo), default Europe/London

name: next_cpi_release
